decisions.reason: Although it is close to our analytics and plugin know-how, its disappearance from the website after launch suggests limited traction or absorption into routine project work, so we would not keep it as a standalone product.
Universal Analytics is obsolete by 2025, so despite our tracking expertise we can no longer turn further learning on this product into commercial value.

The retail system interface plugin fits our development capabilities, but its loss of visibility by 2024 points to weak demand or insufficient scalable learning compared with focusing on broader integration services.

This relaunch SEO support service directly builds on our core shop relaunch, analytics, usability, and search-marketing knowledge and remained actively promoted, which supports continued refinement and commercialization.
SEO workshops are highly adjacent to our existing marketing and advisory capabilities, giving us strong absorptive capacity to improve and sell them further.
